gallery.filename: The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery participates in Wreaths Across America each year to "Remember, Honor, and Teach." Local JR (32055daf-1dd8-b71b-0ba3-93e6d8aa6691).jpg
gallery.title: File:The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery participates in Wreaths Across America each year to "Remember, Honor, and Teach." Local JR (32055daf-1dd8-b71b-0ba3-93e6d8aa6691).jpg
gallery.description:
The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery participates in Wreaths Across America each year to "Remember, Honor, and Teach." Local JR ROTC students work with our veterans to place a wreath on each of the 1800 graves in the cemetery. The event culminates with a moving program and the placement of ceremonial wreaths for each branch of the service, plus MIA/POW.
Keywords: nps centennial
